settings.text: Are you passionate about golf and rocking unique, high-quality apparel? Our Brand Ambassador team is looking for you.
settings.image_alt: Six junior golfers in Golf Asylum polos and caps

settings.heading: Become an Inmate
settings.foot_note: We look forward to hearing from you.

settings.title: What you get
settings.text: A unique discount code to access our gear, as part of a standard one-year agreement.

settings.title: What we ask
settings.text: One post and one story a month on your social platforms, featuring GOLF ASYLUM clothing. Tag GOLF ASYLUM in every post and use #asyluminmate.

settings.title: How to apply
settings.text: Email info@golfasylum.com with your social media handles, a quick bio of your golf journey, any notable achievements, and a picture of yourself in GOLF ASYLUM gear.
